post.description: Creates a disbursement for a worker. A disbursement is an initiation of payment to a worker. In sandbox, providing a value from [this table](/docs/testing-disbursements#generated-response-values-for-mock_response) to `metadata.mock_response` will return a mock disbursement with a corresponding `reason_code`, `status`, and HTTP Response Code.

200.description: Returned if the disbursement already exists and an additional attempt to disburse funds was not made. This can occur if the disbursement was already complete or if the resulting status is in [ CANCELED | SKIPPED | REVERSED ]

201.description: Returned if an attempt to disburse funds was successful. This can occur if the disbursement is new or if it already exists and is retried successfully.

202.description: Returned if an attempt to disburse funds was unsuccessful. This can occur if the resulting status is in [ FAILED | PENDING ]. Additional information can be found via `reason_code`.

400.description: Returned if the request does not adhere to the API specification. Can also be returned if the disbursement cannot be created due to improper invoicing setup.

value.message: Could not match disbursement to invoice configuration

429.description: Returned if the request is throttled. Throttling can occur based on requests/min or if you have reached your organization's daily disbursement limit.

value.message: You have exhausted your API Request Quota

500.description: If persistent, contact your Branch representative.

504.description: Gateway Timeout. An intermittent failure caused by a timeout from a dependency of Branch's systems on both the initial attempt and the automatic fallback retry. Poll to reattempt the payout.

value.message: Disbursement request timed out on initial attempt and fallback retry

delete.description:
Cancels a disbursement.

Disbursements already in `CANCELED` status are accepted as a no-op. Disbursements in `SCHEDULED` or `FAILED` status will be transitioned to `CANCELED`. Attempts to cancel a disbursement with any other status returns a `409` response. Successful cancellation returns a `204` response.

A `CANCELED` disbursement can be retried by calling Create Disbursement using the same (`external_id`, `type`) and `retry: true`.

schema.description: The external ID of the disbursement
The type of the disbursement

404.description: Disbursement not found for the given organization and worker.

409.description: Disbursement is not in a cancelable status. The error message will indicate whether the disbursement is already completed, already reversed, or otherwise not eligible for cancellation.

Returns the worker's available EWA balance.

In sandbox, the following worker IDs are available to return a static balance response:
- `TYPICAL_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns a response with `available_balance` = 5000.
- `NO_AVAILABLE_BALANCE_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns a response with `available_balance` = 0.
- `NOT_FOUND_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns a 404 error indicating the worker was not found.

get.description:
Get EWA account for a worker.

In sandbox, the following worker IDs are available to return a static account response:
- `PENDING_VERIFICATION_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns an account with `status` = `PENDING_VERIFICATION`.
- `VERIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns an account with `status` = `VERIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS`.
- `ACTIVE_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns an account with `status` = `ACTIVE`.
- `FAILED_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns an account with `status` = `FAILED`.
- `SUSPENDED_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns an account with `status` = `SUSPENDED`.
- `NOT_FOUND_SAMPLE_WORKER_ID`: Returns a 404 error indicating the account was not found.

`PENDING`: The disbursement was created, but processing is not yet completed

`FAILED`: Funds were unable to be disbursed

`CANCELED`: Funds were not disbursed and no further action will be attempted for the disbursement

`SKIPPED`: The disbursement was not attempted. See `reason_code` for more information

`LIKELY_MATCH_FOUND`: The disbursement was not attempted because another disbursement was identified as a duplicate

`WORKER_NOT_FOUND`: The worker was not found on the active roster

`PAYMENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND`: No destination account could be found for the provided worker

`PAYMENT_PROFILE_SUSPENDED`: The destination account is not payable due to suspension

`PAYMENT_PROFILE_NOT_ACTIVE`: The destination account is not payable because it is closed or otherwise inactive

`PAYMENT_PROFILE_FRAUDULENT`: The destination account is not payable because it has been closed for fraud

`TRANSFER_FAILED`: An error occurred while issuing the funds to the worker

`AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ORG_SINGLE_DISBURSEMENT_LIMIT`: The amount exceeds the organization's limit for a single disbursement

`AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ORG_DAILY_DISBURSEMENT_LIMIT`: The amount would exceed the organization's daily limit for disbursements

`AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_WORKER_DAILY_DISBURSEMENT_LIMIT`: The amount would exceed the worker's daily limit for disbursements

`AMOUNT_DOES_NOT_COVER_USER_FEES`: The fee to be charged to the worker exceeds or is equal to the disbursement amount

status.description:
##### Basic Statuses:

`CREATED`: A wallet has been created.

`CLOSED`: A wallet has been closed.

`PENDING`: We are attempting to create the wallet. It is not yet available for disbursing funds.

`UNCLAIMED`: A wallet has been created and is able to receive funds through the API, but the employee has not signed up with Branch yet.

`ACTIVE`: A wallet has been created for an employee and they are in control of it.

##### v1.01 Statuses:

`REVIEW`: The user has been flagged for manual review.

`FAILED`: A failure occurred during wallet creation.

reason_code.description:
##### Basic Reason Codes:

`ADDITIONAL_DOCS_REQ`: Branch was not able to confirm identity with the information provided. The user will have to provide additional documentation, like a driver's license, in order to get a wallet on Branch.

`FRAUD_CHECK_REQ`: Branch is performing checks to ensure that the user is not linked in any way to fraudulent activity. Once finished, this user's wallet will be activated. Until then, the wallet that was created for the user will not be able to be funded in any way.

`CONFIRMED_FRAUD`: Branch determined this user to behave in fraudulent activities. As a result, the user will not be allowed to have a wallet on the platform. The wallet created for them will remain closed.

`DENIED`: For one reason or another, the user has been denied access to the platform.

`ERROR`: A system error occurred, please try again.


##### v1.01 Reason Codes:

`KYC_SSN_INVALID`: KYC verification failed due to invalid social security number

`KYC_PII_SSN_MISMATCH`: KYC verification failed due to invalid personal information (name, birthdate)

`KYC_DECEASED`: KYC verification failed due to person reported deceased

`KYC_PO_BOX_NOT_ALLOWED`: KYC verification failed due to PO Box address

`KYC_ERROR`: Unexpected error occurred during KYC step

`ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`: Wallet account was suspended due to failed KYC fraud checks

`ACCOUNT_WITH_EMAIL_EXISTS`: Another Branch account already uses the same email

`EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND`: Employee was not found

`EMPLOYEE_UNDER_AGE`: Employee was not of the minimum age to create an account

`EMPLOYEE_ALREADY_LINKED`: Employee was already linked to another user account

status.description:
##### Basic Statuses:

`NOT_CREATED`: A wallet has not yet been created.

`CREATED`: A wallet has been created.

`CLOSED`: A wallet has been closed.

`PENDING`: We are attempting to create the wallet. It is not yet available for disbursing funds.

`UNCLAIMED`: A wallet has been created and is able to receive funds through the API, but the employee has not signed up with Branch yet.

`ACTIVE`: A wallet has been created for an employee and they are in control of it.

##### v1.01 Statuses:

`REVIEW`: The user has been flagged for manual review.

`FAILED`: A failure occurred during wallet creation.

reason_code.description:
##### Basic Reason Codes:

`ADDITIONAL_DOCS_REQ`: Branch was not able to confirm identity with the information provided. The user will have to provide additional documentation, like a driver's license, in order to get a wallet on Branch.

`FRAUD_CHECK_REQ`: Branch is performing checks to ensure that the user is not linked in any way to fraudulent activity. Once finished, this user's wallet will be activated. Until then, the wallet that was created for the user will not be able to be funded in any way.

`CONFIRMED_FRAUD`: Branch determined this user to behave in fraudulent activities. As a result, the user will not be allowed to have a wallet on the platform. The wallet created for them will remain closed.

`DENIED`: For one reason or another, the user has been denied access to the platform.

`ERROR`: A system error occurred, please try again.


##### v1.01 Reason Codes:

`KYC_SSN_INVALID`: KYC verification failed due to invalid social security number

`KYC_PII_SSN_MISMATCH`: KYC verification failed due to invalid personal information (name, birthdate)

`KYC_DECEASED`: KYC verification failed due to person reported deceased

`KYC_PO_BOX_NOT_ALLOWED`: KYC verification failed due to PO Box address

`KYC_ERROR`: Unexpected error occurred during KYC step

`ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`: Wallet account was suspended due to failed KYC fraud checks

`ACCOUNT_WITH_EMAIL_EXISTS`: Another Branch account already uses the same email

`EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND`: Employee was not found

`EMPLOYEE_UNDER_AGE`: Employee was not of the minimum age to create an account

`EMPLOYEE_ALREADY_LINKED`: Employee was already linked to another user account

status.description:
`ALL`: Search all advances regardless of status

`PAYOUT_NEW`: Payout request is stored, no action taken yet

`PAYOUT_PENDING`: Payout is in progress

`PAYOUT_CANCEL`: Payout has been cancelled

`PAYOUT_TIMEOUT`: Payout was attempted but timed out before completion

`PAYOUT_FAIL`: Payout was attempted and failed

`OUTSTANDING`: Payout has not been paid back and there are no unsettled requested deductions on an active remittance

`PAYBACK_IN_PROGRESS`: Payback is in progress

`PAYBACK_DEFAULTED`: Payback was attempted multiple times and was unsuccessful

`PAYBACK_FAIL`: Payback was attempted but was unsuccessful

`PAYBACK_REFUSED`: Payback was refused by the employee and no further attempts will be made

`PAID`: Payout and corresponding payback are successfully completed

`DEDUCTION_REQUESTED`: An unsettled requested deduction exists on an active remittance

`DEDUCTION_DEFAULTED`: Maximum number of deduction attempts reached for the advance

`DEDUCTION_COMPLETED`: The deduction was completed successfully

`NON_PAYMENT`: Terminal state indicating user insolvency
